title: ReligionWars
description: This server is for making religions and fighting other religions so get on and play!!!
body: This server is where you can make religions(teams) and fight with other people. So when you get on you make a team and you fight with other people until a team wins. Also i added some plugins that can hopefully make it like a actual smp. btw this server auto starts when its offline and when you go in. btw the ip is for java:religionwars.minekeep.gg for bedrock:religionwars.bedrock.minekeep.gg.
